title: Staff training pilot
scenario: An internal learning team plans a small onboarding pilot, clarifies optional participation, and separates feedback gathering from employee assessment.
summary:
The learning team discussed a small pilot of its project-handoff training. The forty-five-minute session would involve around six volunteers working through a fictional handoff and discussing missing information. The group clarified that it was testing the training materials rather than assessing staff performance, and agreed to call the exercise a practice activity. An optional outline would be sent beforehand, with printed materials available during the session.

The activity and answer guide were due Friday afternoon, followed by a review Monday. Feedback would focus on which parts were clear and what needed improvement. Two Wednesday time slots were under consideration; an availability form would determine which to use. The team had not yet made plans for a wider rollout.
